props.label: Before you buy
props.heading: The questions worth asking
props.sub: Ask these of us, and of anyone else you are considering.

items.q: What does NMRDA approval actually mean?
items.a: It means the Nagpur Metropolitan Region Development Authority has sanctioned the layout — the plot boundaries, the road widths and the open spaces are all on record with them. It is what separates a plot you can legally build on and raise a loan against from one you cannot. Ask for the sanction number and check it. We will give you ours.

items.q: What is the difference between an NATP layout and an RL project?
items.a: Both are approved layouts. NA-TP means the land use has been converted to non-agricultural and a town planning layout has been sanctioned. RL is a Regular Layout under NMRDA. In practice the difference matters for which authority holds the file and what the plot can be used for — tell us your purpose and we will point you to the right one.

items.q: Can I get a home loan on these plots?
items.a: On approved, title-clear layouts, yes — that is precisely why the approval matters. Banks lend against sanctioned layouts and will not touch an unapproved one. We will hand over the documents your bank asks for.

items.q: What costs are there beyond the plot price?
items.a: Stamp duty, registration charges, and in some layouts a development or maintenance charge. We will give you the full figure before you commit, not after. If someone quotes you only the per-square-foot rate, ask them the same question.

items.q: Do you handle the paperwork or do I?
items.a: We handle it. From agreement to registration, we prepare the file and follow it up, and we keep you informed at each stage rather than making you chase us.
